{{Quote|Here's a slider for those who like things neat 'n tidy. We serve this one up with a single patty and a precisely measured amount of strider cheese sauce--nothing more, nothing less. It's perfection every time! |Dex's Diner menu, on the Khomm slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Strider cheese sauce''' was a [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] made from [[strider cheese]] and used at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]][[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The sauce was used to make the diner's [[Khomm slider]], a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] created by the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who was inspired<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> by the planet<ref name="Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. The restaurant's menu claimed that the amount of cheese sauce used in the [[slider]] was precisely measured to ensure the dish was perfect every time.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Strider cheese sauce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
